title: SCKit, a worm-like toolkit found in the ScreenConnect MSP attacks, is built to jump from a customer endpoint to the technician who connects to it and on to other managed networks; 288 endpoints across 48 organizations were hit within 90 minutes.
A breach at inference provider Fireworks AI exposed Notion AI chat transcripts, a reminder that your AI subprocessors hold your users' prompts and need the same scrutiny as any data processor.

An attacker used two compromised Qubole IAM users to assume roles that customers had granted Qubole, then emptied Secrets Manager, SSM and S3 across dozens of AWS accounts. Third-party cross-account trust is the attack path, not AWS itself.

Claude Fable 5.2 takes #1 on independent leaderboards (Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 65 vs Gemini 4 Carbon 60), but cost per task rose ~31% on SemiAnalysis's GDPx despite cheaper tokens — effort level now matters as much as model choice.
